title: Flutter Developer
description:
Flutter Developer The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing high-quality applications. You will also be responsible for designing and implementing testable and scalable code. Develop quality mobile and web applications.
 Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain mobile applications using Flutter and Dart. Design highly scalable, testable code. Discover and fix programming bugs. Utilize GitHub for version control and collaborative coding. Integration of native modules and third party SDKs into Flutter codebase. Experience in RESTful APIs to connect to back-end services. Experience in cloud message APIs and push notifications. Experience in all things Android including ADB, EMMI. Experience in application security / encryption. Experience in mobile UI/UX standards. Experience in publishing apps to the App Stores. Experience in benchmarking, performance tuning and code versioning tools such as Git. Willingness to adopt to AI trends and learn new technologies. Communicate effectively with clients to understand their requirements and provide technical solutions. Perks and Benefits Experience in publishing and maintaining Android and iOS apps on the Google and Apple stores. Exposure to mobile security practices including encryption, authentication, and secure data storage. Familiarity with advanced Android and iOS libraries and tools. Strong problem-solving and debugging skills. Excellent communication skills. Passionate about learning new technologies and tools. Stakeholder and cross-team collaboration is required. Role Details Role : Software Developer Location : Dwarka - Delhi Duration : 1-3 Years Salary : 2.5 - 6 LPA Employment Type : Full Time Interview Process Technical Round 1 Technical Round 2 HR Round
